Are you a seasoned product manager looking to build experiences that millions of people rely on to discover new ways to make a living with Uber? Are you energized by creating user journeys where magical experiences, growth, and trust must work hand in hand? If so, this role might be for you.
As a Lead Product Manager your impact on the business side, onboarding, and making new drivers successful is the lifeblood that powers Uber's growth and creates a path to economic empowerment for millions of people every year.
In this role, you will envision and deliver a multi-gig experience that is intuitive, fast, globally scalable and tailored to different earner segments. You will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for how drivers and couriers discover new earning opportunities, maximize their earnings and manage their platform access across all of their gigs.
This role requires strong product sense, a good understanding of the driver persona and their motivations and great crossfunctional agility. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, operations, legal, and trust & safety partners to build experiences that support and scale with the speed of our business.

The Earner growth team sits at the heart of the earner lifecycle and plays a foundational role in Uber's global growth. We are responsible for maximizing the number of quality, high performing earners on the platform.

We achieve this through optimizing the onboarding experience, enabling earners to progress during their early lifecycle and by helping to maximize their earning potential through multiple gigs to increase retention. In the event that earners churn, we also focus on bringing them back to the platform.

Own the product roadmap and lead vision, definition and execution for building Uber's earner multi gig experience.
Rethink the journey - deeply understand earners, their motivations and challenges and keep making the gig discovery and recommendation experience better.
Innovate - find new ways of simplifying the user experience with new technologies.
Distill vision and strategy for the team, get all members of cross-functional team #superpumped.
Own your numbers, drive your cross-functional team of engineers, data scientist, product ops and designers to set qualitative objectives and quantitative goals -- and overachieve them.
Clearly communicate product plans, benefits, and results to leadership.

Minimum of 6 years of product management experience.
Experience delivering highly successful and creative consumer Internet products with your fingerprints all over them - you're proud of what you've accomplished.
Data-driven: you always get the data you need, and you can distill it into an insightful story. Most importantly, you leverage data to drive strategic decisions.
Technical skills. Ability to inform and evaluate engineering decisions.

Any experience working with gig economy earners
Launching products in different international markets
Experience in building and optimizing complex user acquisition funnels or recommendation engines

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of our products and drive company-wide impact! This is a senior-level, subject-matter-expert role that combines strategic vision with hands-on leadership across multiple teams.

The Product team works to design, develop, and manage user-centered digital products that align with our business goals. Through close collaboration with stakeholders, user feedback, and data-driven insights, we deliver innovative and reliable solutions that move the business forward.

Reporting to the Director of Product, you’ll define and deliver a 2–3 year product strategy that aligns with the company’s long-term vision. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to shape development practices, influence roadmaps, and ensure consistent product direction across teams.

As an individual contributor and domain expert, you’ll raise the bar for Product Management through mentorship, technical depth, and scalable processes that promote fact-based problem solving and continuous improvement. This is a remote-first role within the GTA.

Responsibilities: Act as a strategic thought leader, creating clear and inspiring narratives that align teams and stakeholders around a shared product vision.

Define, own, and gain buy-in for the 2-3 year product vision of the assigned domain, and develop a concrete 18-24 month strategy and roadmap that ensures alignment with the overall product and business strategy. Collaborate with Product leaders to co-develop and optimize the overarching 18-24 month product strategy and roadmap.

Partner with Product leadership to shape cross-domain priorities, coordinate resources, and maintain alignment across multiple teams. Serve as the strategic hub and arbiter for product and development teams, resolving significant dependencies and conflicting priorities to drive successful delivery.

Lead end-to-end problem solving from strategy to execution, balancing business and technical needs to maximize impact and ROI. Proactively identify high-value opportunities, assess risks, and align stakeholders on the best path forward.

Collaborate with Engineering leadership to ensure the future state of the product and technical strategy aligns with long-term goals. Establish and share best practices that strengthen strategic planning and execution across the Product team.

Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to raise the organization’s overall strategic and delivery capabilities. Mentor Product Managers on advanced discovery, stakeholder alignment, and strategic execution.

Requirements: University degree or college diploma in a recognized technical, vocational or academic program (preferably in Engineering or Computer Science) or equivalent work 10+ years of experience in digital or software Product Management. 5+ years of experience as a senior individual contributor or an equivalent role in Product Management, with proven hands-on experience leading and implementing company-wide strategic initiatives across multiple product domains and teams.

Proven success owning the full product lifecycle, from 0 to 1 through scale, ideally in a complex, customer-facing platform or self-serve digital product. Strong ability to dive into technical architecture, understand complex data flows, and make informed decisions about platform, infrastructure, and APIs.

Skilled in building and executing product strategy and long-term roadmaps that tie to business outcomes. Deep understanding of strategic frameworks, linking day-to-day execution with long-term company value. Advanced experience in feature planning, resource management, and prioritization across multiple teams.

Proven track record of improving and scaling product processes in collaboration with product leadership. Strong discovery skills, consistently identifying the right problems, validating with data, and applying structured frameworks.

What You Bring: A thoughtful, data-driven approach to decision making and the confidence to prioritize what matters most. A genuine passion for developing the product craft and problem-solving skills of other product managers. Clear and persuasive communication skills, especially when working with executives and cross-functional teams.

You can work independently, navigate ambiguity with ease, and deliver results. Strategic thinking with a systems mindset, anticipating how today’s decisions shape tomorrow’s outcomes. A collaborative and growth-oriented mindset with a passion for mentoring and elevating other Product Managers.

The Role We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the logged-in customer experience at ZenBusiness — the first experience a new business owner sees after signing up and starting to run their company.

This role is about everything that happens after completing their formation: how we keep them coming back, deepening the value they get from our product suite, and turning first-time customers into long-term relationships. You'll own the product roadmap for our native apps (iOS and Android) and web dashboard.

Your mandate is to create a unified, delightful, self-serve experience that helps business owners get more out of every ZenBusiness product they own — from formations and compliance to marketing and fintech — and to drive more awareness and attachment of our highest-value offerings they don’t yet own.

This is a high-visibility individual contributor role that reports directly to the VP of Product, Growth. Responsibilities Build a unified product experience with Velo at the center Define and drive the product roadmap for the logged-in Web & native app experiences, focused on engagement depth, repeat usage, and in-app monetization.

Partner with our Velo team to bring our AI business guide to the center of our logged in experience, leveraging the unique capabilities of our agentic platform to do more for our business owners.

Collaborate closely with the product managers who own our individual products — formations, compliance, marketing, and fintech — to bring the best of each into a single, coherent customer experience. Identify and run experiments to lift core engagement, retention, and product-attachment metrics.

Work cross-functionally with design, engineering, and marketing to execute against that vision. Drive usage and attachment of our highest-value products Drive activation across our product suite by directly leading activation initiatives and equipping other PMs with the tools to drive activation themselves.

If a customer paid for it, your job is to get them to use it. Drive higher activation and usage of our key formations, compliance, marketing, and fintech products by surfacing the right capability at the right moment.

Increase awareness and attachment of our highest-value products through thoughtful CTAs, cross-sell sequencing, and upsell entry points — without compromising the customer experience. Use experimentation and customer data to find friction in the purchase funnel and optimize conversion at every step.

Act as the primary Product point of contact across product marketing, customer success, finance, and other teams that contribute to increasing customer attach rate and retention.

Operate as a builder Use AI across the product lifecycle — research, ideation, prototyping, experiment design — with tools like Claude, Lovable, v0, and Replit as your default mode of working, not a one-off. Prototype your high-potential ideas and put them in front of real customers or internal users for rapid feedback and iteration.

Contribute to our product features that create real customer value — with the judgment to know where AI deepens the experience vs. where it's a distraction. What We're Looking For 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or senior PM level.

Proven track record owning mobile app products (iOS and/or Android) — you understand the platform, the patterns, and how to drive engagement on native surfaces. Demonstrated ability to design unified experiences across multiple products and partner closely with other PMs to make the whole greater than the sum of its parts.

Experience designing self-serve customer experiences with thoughtful escalation paths to human support. Strong instincts around monetization — you know how to position products, write CTAs, structure purchase flows, and find the friction that kills conversion.

Experience working across web and native apps simultaneously; you think in customer journeys, not platforms. Strong collaborator with design and engineering; you can drive decisions without authority. Comfortable in ambiguity — this role requires you to set direction, not execute someone else's roadmap.

Bonus: experience with AI-powered product features, SMB or subscription products, or growth experimentation. Why This Role Matters ZenBusiness serves over 1 million small business owners, and our product suite spans formations, compliance, marketing, and fintech.

Grafana Labs is a remote-first, open-source powerhouse. There are more than 20M users of Grafana, the open source visualization tool, around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps.

The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a NASA launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France.

Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Canada EST. About Product Management: As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs , you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain.

You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders.

The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential. Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM.

You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

As the Senior Product Manager for Infrastructure Observability (Infra O11y) you’ll be responsible for our most popular Grafana Cloud products that span the infrastructure suite: Kubernetes Monitoring and Cloud Provider Observability. Infra O11y provides our customers with the ability to easily monitor their core services – from our smallest self-serve customers to our largest enterprise customers.
Your primary responsibility will be to help define the vision and ensure the long-term success of Infra O11y, working with your engineering partners to fine-tune product strategy. You will be charting the path forward for net-new product initiatives – like Host Monitoring – balanced with maintaining a strong roadmap and customer satisfaction for our most mature products.
Your role will require heavy customer discovery, understanding user needs, and building consensus and alignment across several Engineering groups and many stakeholders as we look towards simplifying our broader Infra O11y experience for Grafana Cloud. You will also need to flex your GTM muscles and build conviction in areas like competitive analysis and sales enablement to better inform activities like pricing and packaging.
Beyond driving your individual product area, you’ll also need to ensure that the experiences you’re building are tightly woven into our overall Grafana Cloud suite of products, by establishing integration touchpoints with other key offerings like Grafana Cloud Knowledge Graph and Grafana Assistant, so that our customers have a seamless monitoring experience where they can easily navigate between different layers of their architecture through guided explorations and natural language.

Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points

Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Sweden. About Product Management: As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs , you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain.

You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders.

The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential. Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM.

You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. The opportunity:
As the Senior Product Manager for Infrastructure Observability (Infra O11y) you’ll be responsible for our most popular Grafana Cloud products that span the infrastructure suite: Kubernetes Monitoring and Cloud Provider Observability. Infra O11y provides our customers with the ability to easily monitor their core services – from our smallest self-serve customers to our largest enterprise customers.
Your primary responsibility will be to help define the vision and ensure the long-term success of Infra O11y, working with your engineering partners to fine-tune product strategy. You will be charting the path forward for net-new product initiatives – like Host Monitoring – balanced with maintaining a strong roadmap and customer satisfaction for our most mature products.
Your role will require heavy customer discovery, understanding user needs, and building consensus and alignment across several Engineering groups and many stakeholders as we look towards simplifying our broader Infra O11y experience for Grafana Cloud. You will also need to flex your GTM muscles and build conviction in areas like competitive analysis and sales enablement to better inform activities like pricing and packaging.
Beyond driving your individual product area, you’ll also need to ensure that the experiences you’re building are tightly woven into our overall Grafana Cloud suite of products, by establishing integration touchpoints with other key offerings like Grafana Cloud Knowledge Graph and Grafana Assistant, so that our customers have a seamless monitoring experience where they can easily navigate between different layers of their architecture through guided explorations and natural language.

Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

Liberis is in the middle of a meaningful shift. We started as a single-product business and are quickly becoming a truly multi-product embedded finance company, with different funding structures, revenue models and customer relationships sitting alongside each other in the same portfolio. That complexity creates real demand for better data, better insight and clearer thinking about how all of it fits together - with this role sitting at the centre of that challange!

As our Senior Data Product Manager, you’ll sit right at the intersection of product, analytics, engineering and senior leadership, helping define the data products that power smarter decisions across Liberis.

You’ll have real ownership over roadmap, prioritisation and ways of working, and your work will directly influence how teams access, understand and use data day to day. This role is a high-impact opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a business uses data at scale!

You’ll be joining a team with a broad remit and a genuine mandate to improve the data experience across the company, so there’s a lot of scope to make the role your own and shape the future of the domain.

You will own the data and insights product for Liberis, building the foundations that let our commercial, credit and operations teams actually understand the business they're running.

That means, thinking carefully about the entities in our data model, how products and customers relate to each other, how those relationships surface in reporting and analysis - and how it eventually all comes out in great dashboards, tools and self-serve capabilities.

This is about shipping products which are genuinely useful, not just technically correct.

Our Engineering Team is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. Data, insights and analytics are a crucial part of that journey and you will be a key player in leading, innovating and rapidly improving our posture and capabilities at the intersection of data and AI.

If you like solving genuinely hard problems, bringing clarity to complex environments and building products that have visible business impact - this is the role for you!

Your primary job is to help Liberis's commercial decision makers understand the small businesses we serve and how they consider, use and perform across our product range. Doing this well requires a clear conceptual model of the business and a willingness to engage with stakeholders across the business, as well as taste and customer empathy in developing a great insights product including dashboards, insight tools and self-serve capabilities.

You will own the roadmap for our internal data & insight products. Working with stakeholders across commercial, credit, finance and operations, you will define what good looks like and then work with your team to build it. You will run prioritisation, manage the backlog and make decisions about where effort goes.

You will also spend a meaningful amount of time in the detail, reviewing data models and dashboards, asking hard questions about definitions, and making sure what we ship is accurate and trusted.

You will partner closely with the engineering side of your team on how data is modelled and structured in BigQuery and DBT, and with analysts on how it gets presented in Looker. You don't need to write production code, but you need enough technical understanding to be a genuine partner in those conversations. You will also be responsible for continuing to expand our partner-facing reporting, whereby partners gain visibility into their portfolio.

This role requires someone who can think clearly about complex data structures and translate that thinking into products that non-technical people actually find useful. The ideal person has strong conceptual thinking skills, great product instincts and enough technical depth to earn the trust of the engineers and analysts they work with.

· Proven experience in a senior data product or analytics product role in a business with real complexity

· A track record of helping commercial teams make better decisions through better data, not just shipping dashboards

· Strong ability to think about entities, taxonomies and relationships in data

· Hands-on experience with Looker and LookML and familiarity with best practices and scalable approaches to these systems

· Working knowledge of SQL, DBT and BigQuery, enough to engage seriously with how data is modelled and what's feasible, and to express your thinking in code-speak where needed

· Experience working with a multi skilled team of analysts and data engineers

· Clear, confident communication with senior commercial stakeholders

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on

Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week, but ideally 4 days. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

Chez BOBST, nous transformons la manière dont nos collaborateurs collaborent, communiquent et utilisent l'IA pour travailler plus intelligemment chaque jour.

* Une expérience significative dans le Travail Numérique, Microsoft 365 ou les plateformes de collaboration.
* Une solide connaissance de Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online et de l'écosystème Microsoft 365.
* Une expérience en tant que Responsable Produit ou dans un rôle similaire pilotant des produits et services digitaux.
* Un intérêt pour les solutions de productivité alimentées par l'IA et l'expérience employé.
* De fortes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes et en communication.
* Maîtrise de l'anglais et du français.

Chez BOBST, vous rejoindrez un leader technologique mondial où l'innovation, la collaboration et l'apprentissage continu guident tout ce que nous faisons.

* Diriger des initiatives stratégiques en Travail Numérique et IA.

Du arbeitest gerne kollaborativ und standortübergreifend mit Kollegen in Hamburg und Naarden zusammen.

Anyone can build AI insurance software now. The models are commoditized. The demos work. Almost nobody starts where Agency Revolution starts: thousands of independent P&C agencies already paying us to communicate with their clients, plus deep integrations into the systems where agency data actually lives.
The opportunity is the relationship layer — the system that notices when an agency's clients are at risk of churning, spots the cross-sell opportunity, picks the right message and channel and moment, and acts. We call it RelationshipOS. For ten years, agencies have trusted us to speak to their clients.

Now we're expanding what we can see: call transcripts, carrier communications, life events. The policies live in the agency's management system. The relationship lives with us. Nobody else has both the permission and the infrastructure.
We know what we're betting on. We don't yet know what makes an agency owner act on it. That's the job.
The strategic thesis is set. What's unresolved is whether it's true — whether an agency will actually change what they do because our system told them to, and what has to be built for that to happen. You're hired to answer that by shipping, not by studying.

s.h: Two halves, and you need both
s.t:
You personally build the bet. The intelligence layer is your work. Discovery with agency owners, prototypes in front of them within days, the smallest version that proves someone will act. Much of this is assembled rather than authored — the right vendor wired into AR Connect and pointed at a real use case will beat anything we could build from scratch this year. You don't hand this half to your team; it's too early and too ambiguous to delegate.
Your team drives the day-to-day execution and health of the existing platform. Two Product Owners and a Product Analyst keep a profitable, decade-old product healthy and improving. You set their priorities, strengthen their product judgment, raise their craft, and shield them from thrash. You remain the primary product manager responsible for the roadmap, discovery, and strategic product decisions. Done well, this is what buys you the time to do the first half.
Most people are good at one of these. We need someone who won't quietly abandon the other.
This position offers $125,000-$140,000 depending on experience and qualifications.

RelationshipOS — the intelligence layer. Churn signals. Cross-sell opportunities. Adaptive customer journeys instead of rigid sequences. You define what "acted on" means, instrument it, and are accountable for the number.
AR Connect and the vendor stack. AR Connect is our integration layer — where APIs pull in calls, carrier communications, life events, and other signals, and where third-party capability plugs into our distribution. It's the substrate the whole thesis sits on, and it's how a promising vendor becomes a live use case in front of agencies.
That work is yours: mapping the landscape of management systems, carrier connections, data enrichment providers, and AI vendors; deciding what we integrate versus build; running the POCs; and getting from "interesting demo" to something an agency actually uses. Data quality, latency, unit economics, and what happens when a vendor's model is wrong are your problems to surface early. You shape the deals and bring the recommendation — the SVP and our partnership team close them.
Voice AI as a channel. Not a feature — a real channel. Define the MVP, run pilots where AI handles outbound outreach with warm handoffs to agencies, and produce the evidence for whether this moves us from subscription toward outcome-based pricing.
The Agency Revolution roadmap. What ships, in what order, and what we stop doing. You own the sequencing and defend it.

In just five years, Stora has become the platform behind more than 30% of UK self storage locations, and we're scaling globally from here. Operators have processed over £150m in automated payments through us, and see an average of 32% business growth after they switch.
We're doing this in a market that's wide open. Europe has over 10,000 self storage sites and is growing fast, yet it sits years behind the US on maturity and is still barely touched by good software. The UK is our stronghold. The rest of Europe is where we're heading next.
Stora is the operating system for modern self storage: online bookings, payments, facility management, reporting, and automation in one platform. We started as operators ourselves, and that's still how we think. If you want to own a product operators depend on every day, in a company genuinely rethinking how it builds, this is it.
Why this role matters
We have a strong product team, great engineers, and a growing product. The bottleneck isn't ideas or execution capacity. It's people who can hold the full picture at once.
What the business needs, what the customer actually experiences, what's technically feasible, what to cut when time is short, and knowing when to slow down. Making good calls across all of it. That's the job.
We've shortened the loop between insight and shipped product by stripping out the layers that slow good judgement down. The quality bar didn't move. This role exists to keep doing that. It carries real ownership from day one, and the scope grows as Stora does.
The surface you'd own
This is the product operators live in every day, and the storefront their own customers book through. You're designing for two users at once: the operator running the business, and the end customer renting the unit. Getting that B2B2C experience right is a genuine craft problem. It's a broad, central surface, and it's heavy on UX.

Core workflows: customers, units, tenancies, access
Roles, permissions, account structure
Operational reporting: occupancy, utilisation, activity
The internal data layer: event tracking, core models, metric definitions
The growth surface: storefront, checkout, the lead → booking funnel
If an operator uses it daily, or relies on it to understand their business, it sits with this team.
How we actually work
We've changed how product gets built at Stora. This is how we operate now.
Designers work directly in the codebase. Engineers and product people work closely together from the start. We use AI genuinely: to explore, prototype and move faster. The work gets closer to reality, sooner.
If you're at a company that talks about moving faster but runs the same process it did three years ago, this will feel different. We're not done evolving how we work, and this person will have real scope to shape that.

Oula delivers maternity care built around our patients—offering comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach is delivering better outcomes. Our team of trusted midwives, OBGYNs, and dedicated care navigators ensure our patients get the type of care they need in the moments that matter most.
Since launching in 2021, we’ve expanded to include Preconception and Miscarriage Care, Pregnancy Care, Postpartum Support, and Gynecology. We currently have 4 clinics in the tri-state area, with three new clinics opening in 2026! Come join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

Product Manager
Full-Time
New York, Chicago or Charlotte
Reports to VP, Central Operations
About Oula
Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. We partner exclusively with major health systems — including Mount Sinai, Stamford Health, and Novant Health — to embed our collaborative OB-GYN and midwifery model directly inside their networks. We're a team of ~100 people at Series B stage, with 4 clinics today and three more opening in 2026.

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR — it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.
We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack — including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.
You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver.

You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.
What You'll Own
EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems
Own day-to-day management of our core tech stack: the EHR, patient portal, and care management platform
Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff
Lead EHR integration efforts as the internal and external subject matter expert — FHIR/HL7 data exchange, health system IT coordination and committed go-live timelines
Own and accelerate Epic integration timelines as we onboard additional health system partners
Maintain configuration integrity as new markets launch and care model workflows evolve
Partner with our IT team on infrastructure; own the clinical systems layer they don't touch
Product Operations & Launch
Own bug intake and prioritization from Market Operations — standardize how Engineering receives, scopes, and resolves issues and communicates status back to the field
Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations
Identify where AI and automation can reduce manual administrative burden in product operations workflows
Standards & Knowledge Management
Build and maintain the clinical systems SOP library so new market setup is repeatable — documented well enough that a new hire can execute without you in the room
Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling
Drive feature parity efforts so patients and clinicians experience a consistent standard of care across markets
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain dashboards tracking feature adoption, issue resolution, and rollout health across clinics
Develop quarterly reporting for Product, leadership, and health system partners on platform performance
Ensure data infrastructure is in place to measure the impact of every feature rollout

3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work — ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company
Strong problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity — you like figuring out how things work and making them work better
Ease with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this role requires you to create the playbook, not execute someone else's
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive aggressive timelines — ideally with client-facing or health system-facing experience
Ability to speak ‘multiple languages’ – comfort going deep on technical details while communicating clearly to non-technical audiences; you can write a bug ticket, an SOP, and a launch plan that people actually follow; hands-on EHR configuration and integration experience strongly preferred
Analytical enough to build a dashboard and identify a pattern, even if you're not a SQL expert
What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.
At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.
At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

In this role, you will develop a deep understanding of business applications, technology platforms, and software delivery processes to support specialized information security and application security risk discussions. The role serves as a technical Application Security subject matter expert responsible for reviewing, validating, analyzing, and adjudicating application security findings identified through enterprise security testing platforms, including Checkmarx One.

This includes performing detailed source code analysis, vulnerability validation, exploitability assessments, risk evaluations, and disposition decisions to ensure security findings are accurately assessed, consistently governed, and aligned with enterprise security standards and risk-management objectives.
The successful candidate will partner closely with development teams, architects, security engineers, product owners, and risk partners to drive secure development practices, vulnerability remediation, and risk-based security decision making across the enterprise.

· Possess a strong application security background with extensive knowledge of software development methodologies, SDLC processes, software architecture, and secure coding practices.

· Serve as the primary technical reviewer and adjudicator for application security findings generated through Checkmarx One and other approved security testing technologies.

· Review, analyze, validate, and disposition application security findings using evidence-based technical analysis.

· Independently validate vulnerability findings rather than relying solely on automated scanner results, developer rationale, AI-generated recommendations, or previous dispositions.

· Analyze source code, application architecture, APIs, business logic, trust boundaries, data flows, and software design patterns to assess vulnerability validity and security impact.

· Evaluate exploitability, reachability, attack paths, compensating controls, exposure conditions, and real-world security risk.

· Review and validate developer-submitted adjudication requests, including Proposed Not Exploitable determinations and supporting evidence packages.

· 10+ years of Information Security, Application Security, Secure Software Development, or Technology Risk Management experience.

· 5+ years of experience in Application Security, Secure Software Development, Vulnerability Management, Security Architecture, or Information Security Risk Management.

· Strong experience performing source code analysis, vulnerability validation, application security assessments, and security testing.

· Subject matter expertise in Application Security, Secure SDLC, Vulnerability Management, Threat Modeling, Secure Coding Practices, OWASP Top 10, and Common Weakness Enumerations (CWE).

· Experience with Checkmarx One or comparable enterprise application security testing platforms.

· Ability to evaluate, validate, and adjudicate complex SAST, SCA, API Security, and related application security findings using risk-based analysis.

· Experience identifying false positives, exploitability constraints, compensating controls, and appropriate risk treatment strategies.

· Strong understanding of modern application architectures, APIs, microservices, cloud-native technologies, and DevSecOps practices.

· Experience evaluating application security controls across cloud, SaaS, PaaS, distributed, and on-premises environments.

· Strong knowledge of NIST, ISO, PCI DSS, and related security frameworks.

· Ability to communicate technical security findings, risk decisions, and remediation guidance to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and risk assessment skills.

· Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related field.

· CISSP, CSSLP, CISM, CRISC, GIAC, OSCP, or equivalent industry certifications.

· Experience supporting enterprise application security programs and secure software development initiatives.

· Experience with AI-assisted development and code-analysis tools such as GitHub Copilot.
